method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, vicariate, parish, mission, monastery, chapel, and assembly sources were checked. Search and map results were used only for discovery and were not accepted as proof of canonical parentage or current worship. Overlapping canonical structures are retained when each current authority documents its own body.

candidates.jurisdiction: Georgian Orthodox Church, Eparchy of Western Europe
candidates.name: Current Georgian Orthodox parish roster in Italy
candidates.status: official church roster required before publication
candidates.reason: The official Italian episcopal assembly confirms the Georgian Patriarchate as a recognized jurisdiction. A 2025 academic study reports 22 Georgian churches in Italy, and official Georgian government material confirms the Saint Andrew parish in Rome. No current parish list from the Georgian Patriarchate or its Western European eparchy was available, so no individual Georgian body is published from secondary evidence.
discovery_names: Saint Andrew the First-Called Parish, Rome

candidates.name: Possible separately organized OCU bodies in Italy
candidates.status: no current separate body established by official evidence
candidates.reason: Official OCU material documents visits and pastoral relations with the Ecumenical Patriarchate's Metropolis of Italy, but no separately organized current OCU parish, mission, monastery, or chapel in Italy was found.

candidates.name: Possible Antiochian congregations in Italy
candidates.reason: Search and map discovery results were not matched to a current official patriarchal, archdiocesan, or parish source. They are not published.

historical_or_reconciled.name: Udine, Treviso, and Porcia
historical_or_reconciled.result: Current patriarchal reporting treats the three places as the one Parish of Saint Despot Stefan the New. Udine is published as the parish, with Treviso and Porcia as its worship sites.

historical_or_reconciled.name: Milan dedication
historical_or_reconciled.result: The current 2026 patriarchal report names Saint Simon the Monk. That current dedication supersedes the older Saint Stephen the First-Crowned wording still visible in the diocesan directory.

historical_or_reconciled.name: Saint Nicholas complex in Bari
historical_or_reconciled.result: The Moscow Patriarchate and the current ROCOR diocesan directory each document a current structure at Corso Benedetto Croce 130. Both are retained under their respective canonical parents.

historical_or_reconciled.name: Malta and San Marino entries
historical_or_reconciled.result: The official Italy diocesan directory includes Malta and San Marino. Those entries, including the Malta filial church, are excluded from the Italy payload because they belong to separate country modules.

historical_or_reconciled.name: San Marino Parish of Saint Michael the Archangel
historical_or_reconciled.result: The official Italy archdiocesan list includes this San Marino body. It is excluded from the Italy payload because it belongs to the separate San Marino country module.

historical_or_reconciled.jurisdiction: Archdiocese of Orthodox Churches of Russian Tradition in Western Europe
historical_or_reconciled.name: Former Florence and Sanremo listings
historical_or_reconciled.result: They are absent from the current official Italy deanery taxonomy and appear in the current ROCOR directory. They are published only under ROCOR.
